sources.title: AI 3D Model Generator for FiveM | Model Forge
sources.snippet: Model Forge turns a text prompt or a reference image into a game-ready 3D model using Tripo AI. Output is a .glb file with embedded PBR textures that drops straight into Blender, Maya, UV Studio, and Paint Booth — and converts cleanly to YDR for FiveM. Every model is polygon-customizable and saved to your personal library.
